It is simple, easy to use, and effective.”</div><div class="home-quote-holder-info-credit"><p>Neil Patel</p>Digital Marketing Expert</div></div></div></section><hr/></div><section class="home-uses"><div class="content"><h2 class="centered">🙌  Avoid the inbox, reach your customers directly.</h2><h4 class="centered">Even great marketing messages can get caught by spam filters or be buried in a overflowing inbox. With Subscribers you’ll avoid the inbox entirely – no waiting for emails to be opened, no third party messaging apps to configure. Get in touch with your customers any time, any day.</h4><div class="home-uses-detail"><div class="home-uses-detail-info"><div class="home-use" data-index="0"><div class="home-use-icon" data-index="0"><img alt="" src="/static/media/icon-small-eye.ff398367.svg"/></div><div class="home-use-info"><h3>Delivery, No Matter What</h3>Rest assured that even if a subscriber isn't online when your message is sent, they'll see your notification immediately once they get back online.</div></div><div class="home-use" data-index="1"><div class="home-use-icon" data-index="1"><img alt="" src="/static/media/icon-small-alarm.b7414769.svg"/></div><div class="home-use-info"><h3>Schedule In Advance</h3>Schedule your push notifications as far in advance as you want so you can focus your time where it matters most.</div></div><div class="home-use" data-index="2"><div class="home-use-icon" data-index="2"><img alt="" src="/static/media/icon-small-time.ca3bbe7f.svg"/></div><div class="home-use-info"><h3>Target By Timezone</h3>Optimize your click through rates and increase engagement by having your notifications delivered based on your subscribers' local class="centered">💡  Web Push Notifications 101</h2><h4 class="centered">What are web push notifications? Glad you asked. Web push notifications are a new, modern channel of communication between you, a site owner, and your visitors. Notifications are delivered <em>directly</em> to your visitors' screens – no inbox, no messaging app, no questions.</h4><div class="home-101-detail"><div class="home-101-detail-info right"><h3>Bite-Size Messages</h3>Say what you need to say quickly and easily in a consumable, bit-size message. Up your views, shares, and purchases.</div><div class="home-highlight"><div class="home-highlight-icon"><img alt="" src="/static/media/icon-stats.3af0cf92.svg"/></div><h3>Re-Engage Existing Customers</h3>It can cost 25x more to acquire a new customer than to re-engage someone who has purchased from your site before. Send push notifications to lead existing customers back to your site and encourage another purchase.</div><div class="home-highlight"><div class="home-highlight-icon"><img alt="" src="/static/media/icon-new-customers.5f7f786e.svg"/></div><h3>Make New Customers Stick</h3>Our welcome drips see a 14% click through rate on average. That's almost 7 times the standard click through rates on email welcome series.</div></section></div></section><section class="home-ecommerce"><div class="content"><h2 class="centered">🛒  eCommerce Integrations</h2><h4 class="centered">Subscribers has deep integrations with the top eCommerce providers, allowing you to target notifications to your store’s customers based on their browsing and purchasing history (or lack there of!)</h4><div class="home-ecommerce-detail"><section class="home-highlights"><div class="home-highlight"><div class="home-highlight-icon"><img alt="" src="/static/media/icon-shopping-cart.ce4fc7ae.svg"/></div><h3>Abandoned Cart</h3>Are your customers just forgetful or do they need that little extra something to complete their purchases? Either way, Subscribers' Abandoned Cart features will help you recover those lost sales. You can send a friendly reminder or even add an incentive for finishing a purchase.</div><div class="home-highlight"><div class="home-highlight-icon"><img alt="" src="/static/media/icon-sale.d5e60481.svg"/></div><h3>Announce Inventory Changes</h3>Bring your customers or potential customers back by letting them know when the price on a product they like has gone down, or something they wanted but was out of stock has come back in stock. Subscribers’ easy to use Inventory Change features help you automatically bring customers back for more purchases on the specific products they have shown interest in.</div><div class="home-highlight"><div class="home-highlight-icon"><img alt="" src="/static/media/icon-package.cfc5f46a.svg"/></div><h3>Trending Products</h3>Your customers want to know when new products hit your store and which products are most popular across your site. With Subscribers' Trending Products features, you can regularly keep customers coming back to purchase the latest and greatest products you have to offer.</div></section><div
